observations: A black Nikon DSLR camera body is shown with two lenses.
One lens is attached to the camera, showing the front element and lens cap.
The other lens is detached and placed beside the camera, also with a lens cap.
The camera body has a red accent on the mode dial and a strap attached.
The background is a dark, textured surface, possibly a table or stand.
No visible damage to the camera body or lenses in the photo.
The seller claims two lenses: 18-55mm and 50mm, and that they are clean and good for video and snapshots.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: No visible damage or dirt in photo 0, but internal condition, sensor cleanliness, and functionality cannot be assessed remotely. No video or snapshot test is shown.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear lens showing the lens cap, front element, and any visible scratches or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having only one lens (18-55mm) or as a non-functional lens

risks.risk: The camera may have internal damage, sensor issues, or electronic faults not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording a short video clip.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
